description: Fast-path signals to the agent-orchestration Worker, shared by every loop. PostToolUse fires after every tool call in the loop's session. In a session the Worker fired (its first prompt carries route=… repo=… number=…), the hook POSTs to AGENT_OUTCOMES_ENDPOINT (the Worker's /routine-signal, bearer AGENT_OUTCOMES_TOKEN): a completion when the call posted an <!-- agent-outcome:<routine> --> artifact, else a heartbeat naming the step at most once a minute. Never the authoritative signal: the GitHub write the loop already made is. See docs/agent-orchestration/11-outcome-artifact.md in umbraco-mcp-ops.
